title: 1 second resolution for st.time_input
body:
### Problem

I would like to allow user input for time to the precision of seconds. Currently, the `st.time_input` widget only allows selection of hour and minutes, which is a limitation if we want higher level time precision.

### Solution

I would love to see seconds- and possibly milliseconds-level precision in the `st.time_input` widget. In many cases, we might need different levels of precision, so perhaps it would make sense for users to select the level of precision, whether that is 'minutes', 'seconds' or 'milliseconds'.

I hope you will consider implementing this feature as it would greatly expand the capability for web apps that require high precision time input. Thanks!

---

Community voting on feature requests enables the Streamlit team to understand which features are most important to our users.

**If you'd like the Streamlit team to prioritize this feature request, please use the 👍 (thumbs up emoji) reaction in response to the initial post.**

comments.body: See also #4693. We'll actually launch this on Thursday with the next release! `st.time_input` will get a step parameter that will let you specify the step between consecutive times. It's limited to min. 60 seconds at the moment since going lower would have been a lot more effort to implement. So I'll leave this open and we'll use it as a request for a lower bound ;)
Keen to see this added, particularly useful when working with time series IOT data
Same here, working with time-series IoT data and really need proper second support (at least). :)
[USER] What was the blocker from being able to specify a value for `step` of less than 60?

> What was the blocker from being able to specify a value for step of less than 60?

The [time picker component from BaseWeb](https://baseweb.design/components/time-picker/) that we use only allows showing hours/minutes, not seconds.
